name: revision-maps-store
description: Multi-niche store of visual revision maps (PDF) — content pipeline and sales site.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run validate && npm test
scripts.site:dev: npm run site:assets && SITE_MODE=preview next dev
scripts.site:preview: npm run build:preview && npm run site:assets && SITE_MODE=preview NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next build
scripts.site:build: npm run validate:release && npm run build:pdfs && npm run site:assets && SITE_MODE=release NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 next build
scripts.site:package: npm run site:build && mkdir -p entrega && rm -f entrega/helptest-site-*.zip && cd out && zip -qrX ../entrega/helptest-site-$(date +%F).zip index.html . -x 'index.txt' '*/index.txt' '*__next*'
